questions.questionText: Between January 2020 and December 2020, the rate of unemployment in the UK increased from 3.9% to 5.2%. This was as a result of the UK economy experiencing a recession. With reference to the information above, explain one possible effect of the increase in the rate of unemployment on the UK government budget.
In 2023 the UK government reduced indirect tax on certain goods and services. Define the term ‘indirect tax’.
In 2023 the UK government reduced indirect tax on certain goods and services. Which one of the following is an example of an indirect tax?
With reference to the information provided, explain two factors that the Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee may have considered when changing the base interest rate.
The table below shows the UK’s budget deficit between March 2016 and March 2019. Define the term ‘budget deficit’.

The table below shows the UK’s budget deficit between March 2016 and March 2019. Using the above table, calculate the percentage decrease in budget deficit between March 2016 and March 2019. You are advised to show your working.
The table below shows the UK’s budget deficit between March 2016 and March 2019. Which one of the following will most likely lead to a reduction in the budget deficit?
options: An increase in government spending and a decrease in taxation
An increase in taxation and a decrease in government spending
An increase in the value of exports and a decrease in the value of imports
An increase in the value of imports and a decrease in the value of exports
